classical_full.label: Classical SVM (Full)
classical_full.description: Classical RBF-SVM trained on all 87 features and 9,144 samples. This is the model used in the live URL analyser.

classical_fair.label: Classical SVM (Fair)
classical_fair.description: Classical RBF-SVM constrained to the same 6 features and 200 samples as the quantum models. Used as the fair head-to-head baseline â€” not the live analyser model.

qsvm.label: QSVM (Quantum Kernel)
qsvm.description: Quantum SVM using a 6-qubit PennyLane circuit with ZZ-style feature map. Trained on the same 200 samples and 6 features as the fair classical SVM.

qnn.label: QNN (Variational Circuit)
qnn.description: Variational QNN with 3 layers (Rot+CNOT) on 6 qubits. Trained with Adam (lr=0.01) for 100 epochs on 200 samples.

qsvm_reupload.label: QSVM v2 (Data Re-uploading)
qsvm_reupload.description: Same 6-qubit ZZ-style feature map as the baseline QSVM, but the encode-entangle block is re-uploaded 2x (Perez-Salinas et al. 2020 data re-uploading) instead of once. Same data split, same C=10. Isolates the effect of feature-map depth on the same 200 training samples.

qnn_reupload.label: QNN v2 (Data Re-uploading)
qnn_reupload.description: Same 3-layer Rot+ring-CNOT circuit and 54 parameters as the baseline QNN, but the input is re-uploaded (Perez-Salinas et al. 2020) before every layer instead of once at the start. Same data split, same 100-epoch Adam training. Isolates the effect of re-uploading on the same 200 training samples.
